targets.adjudication_verdict: GENUINE PASS with one recorded mediation caveat. The rescue is real on every guard the vacuous-pass families require: (a) arms differ (warmed {16,12,42} vs control {3,0,0}, per-seed variance real); (b) controls were genuinely exposed past the gate (control seed 23: 570 converged ticks, 0 events -- so the control zero is not starvation of the denominator); (c) direction survives rate normalization (12/67 = 0.179 events/converged-tick treated vs 0/570 control on the canonical failing seed 23); (d) threshold inherited from 779b, not fitted; (e) the pre-warmup event count INVERTS (controls 17-19, warmed 4-8), matching the stated hypothesis that the untrained PE stream is early-lifetime transient noise. Caveat (recorded, does not overturn): warmup training also drastically restructures episode length (control seed 23 = 87 episodes of ~6.9 steps, the exact 779b binding-axis signature; warmed = 3-14 long episodes), and the criterion is an absolute count. Since SD-075's own diagnosis named episode length as the binding axis, training's effect on episode structure is PART of the rescue mechanism, not a confound against the diagnostic's question -- the future retest would run under the same joint conditions. ISOLATION GAP (red-team finding, stated explicitly): the regulator's 30-tick convergence gate is LIFETIME-denominated and does not re-arm per episode under reset mode, so carry mode's MARGINAL contribution over reset was not isolated by this design -- an identical rescue might have occurred with continuity=reset once episodes are long. This does not touch the pre-registered JOINT question (training + carry) or the recommended retest, which inherits both conditions; a 3-cell reset+warmup arm is the cheap confirmer if the isolation ever matters. The label is accurate at its stated scope: a new-number MECH-063(ii) retest using carry mode + warmup exposure is now evidence-supported.

learning_extracted: The re-derive brake worked end to end: 779b's brake refused the cheap 779c step-cap re-run, routed to /implement-substrate (SD-075, built 2026-07-19), and this probe then converted the build into an evidence-supported retest design at diagnostic cost instead of burning another lettered evidence run.

When a treatment (training) jointly moves the DV's mechanism and a structural covariate (episode length), and the covariate is itself the diagnosed binding axis, the joint effect is the answer to a retest-design question -- record the mediation honestly rather than calling it a confound.
Formalising a never-run scratch spike into a queue-visible diagnostic (952 from sd075_warmup_rescue_spike.py) is the correct path -- the spike alone would have answered nothing durably.
